sources.citation: Gas Man Workbook and Laboratory Manual. Default Options: Patient Defaults.
sources.note: The default 70 kg patient uses alveolar volume 2.5 L, venous volume 1.0 L, alveolar ventilation 4 L/min, cardiac output 5 L/min, tissue volumes 6/33/14.5 L, and flow percentages 76/18/6.

sources.citation: Meybohm P, et al. Context-sensitive decrement times for inhaled anesthetics in obese patients explored with Gas Man. Journal of Clinical Monitoring and Computing. 2021;35:897-908.
sources.note: Published description of the standard 70 kg Gas Man model and its compartment parameters.
